<!--
  Customer reviews as cards or plain entries: rating, title, text, author and date. Axes: layout (list, grid),
  columns, item (card, plain), avatar (none, image), tone, density.
-->
<script lang="ts" module>
  import type { Snippet } from "svelte";
  import type { Review, ReviewLabels } from "./review-list.types";

  export type ReviewListProps = {
    id: string;
    title: string;
    reviews: Review[];
    labels: ReviewLabels;
    layout?: "list" | "grid";
    item?: "card" | "plain";
    avatar?: "none" | "image";
    tone?: "default" | "muted";
    density?: "default" | "roomy";
  };
</script>

<script lang="ts">
  import Block from "../primitives/block/block.svelte";
  import Grid from "../primitives/grid/grid.svelte";
  import Group from "../primitives/group/group.svelte";
  import Stack from "../primitives/stack/stack.svelte";
  import Text from "../primitives/text/text.svelte";
  import Title from "../primitives/title/title.svelte";
  import MediaFrame from "../components/media-frame.svelte";
  import Rating from "../components/rating.svelte";
  import SectionFrame from "../components/section-frame.svelte";
  import { cn, tpl } from "../utils";

  let {
    id,
    title,
    reviews,
    labels,
    layout = "list",
    item = "card",
    avatar = "none",
    tone = "default",
    density = "default",
  }: ReviewListProps = $props();
</script>

<SectionFrame
  id={id}
  title={title}
  tone={tone}
  density={density}
  measure={(((layout as string) === "list") ? "2xl" : "default")}
>
  <Grid cols={(((layout as string) === "grid") ? "1-3" : "1")} class="gap-4" data-testid="items">
    {#each reviews as r (r.id)}
      <Block
        tag="article"
        class={cn(
          "flex h-full flex-col gap-4",
          (
            (item as string) === "card" ? "rounded bg-card p-6 inset-ring inset-ring-border"
            : "border-b border-border pb-4"
          )
        )}
        data-testid="item"
      >
        <Rating value={r.rating} label={tpl(labels.ratingLabel, r.rating)} size={16} />
        <Title as={3} size="base" weight="bold">
          {r.title}
        </Title>
        <Text size="sm" class="text-muted-foreground">
          {r.text}
        </Text>
        <Group gap="4" align="center" class="mt-auto">
          {#if ((avatar as string) === "image")}
            <MediaFrame alt={r.author} ratio="1/1" class="size-10 shrink-0 rounded-full" />
          {/if}
          <Stack gap="0">
            <Text size="sm" weight="semibold">
              {r.author}
            </Text>
            <Text size="xs" class="text-muted-foreground">
              {r.date}
            </Text>
          </Stack>
        </Group>
      </Block>
    {/each}
  </Grid>
</SectionFrame>
